title: Animated Axolotl Totem
description: A small addon for Refined Buckets and Punchy that makes the Totem of Undying appear as an animated axolotl bucket when held. Similar to Bedrock's Actions & Stuff!
body:
Makes the Totem of Undying appear as an animated axolotl bucket when held, powered by Punchy and Refined Buckets.

Requirements

### Features - Replaces the held **Totem of Undying** with an animated **Axolotl Bucket**. - Keeps the vanilla Totem of Undying icon in inventories, GUIs, and item frames. - Uses Refined Buckets' animations through Punchy for seamless integration. - Works in both the main hand and offhand. ### Installation 1. Install **Refined Buckets**. 2. Install **Punchy**. 3. Place this resource pack **above Refined Buckets** in your resource pack list. ### Troubleshooting - If the held item appears misaligned or behaves unexpectedly, try disabling **Item Physics** in Punchy's settings. - Ensure this resource pack is loaded **above Refined Buckets**. ### Credits - **Refined Buckets** — Models, textures, and animations. - **Punchy** — Item animation framework.
